# name: Build & Deploy to GCP Artifact Registry

# on:
#   push:

# # This env can also be used in all jobs/steps

# # Remember, you can only use env in "run" (eg: run: echo "IMAGE_NAME=$IMAGE_NAME").
# env:
#   IMAGE_NAME: api
#   BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
